name: Hades Mining (Hades Resources GmbH; brand 'Hades')
what: Deep-tech extraction company building high-power laser drilling to reach ultra-deep geothermal heat and recover critical minerals by in-situ recovery; holds a rare-earth exploration licence at Storkwitz, Germany.
homonym_note: Legal entity is Hades Resources GmbH (imprint); press uses Hades Mining and Hades.

membership.basis: Listed on the live tomorrow.vc portfolio (tomorrow-2026); the firm's own post says it first backed Hades at the Aug 2025 pre-seed and doubled down at the Feb 2026 seed; the Tomorrow Fund I register page shows a Hades Resources GmbH shareholder list (2026-03-02, 2026-03-12).
membership.quote: We first backed Hades in its €5.5M Pre-Seed in August 2025

entry.quote: Led by Project A, other participants in the round include Visionaries Tomorrow

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Hades Mining" / "Hades Resources" / "Hades" critical minerals raises -> pre-seed (Aug 2025), EUR 15M Seed (Feb 2026), Rio Tinto/Founders Factory accelerator (Mar 2026), Storkwitz licence (Aug 2026); no Series A
WebSearch (1 call): Munich Startup 2026-02-17 and tomorrow.vc post confirm the Feb 2026 round is named Seed
notes: Follow-on: the EUR 15M Seed (Sifted 2026-02-11; Munich Startup 2026-02-17: 'Project A and Visionaries Tomorrow are participating again') is named Seed, so under the graduation rule it does not graduate the row even though it is about 2.7x the pre-seed and above $5M: the unnamed-round test applies only to unnamed rounds; judge to confirm. Valuation: Sifted's subhead 'is valued at €67.5m'; it does not say pre- or post-money, recorded as post-money primary with that caveat. Founding year not published (company emerged from stealth in Aug 2025; imprint last updated 2025-08-13). Focus: laser drilling hardware for extraction and geothermal reads as Industrial & Robotics; Climate & Energy is the alternative (geothermal heat sales).
